updates.title: Gun For Hire Team Steps Up Aboard Flight 618
updates.summary: Rich and Juan from Gun For Hire helped the crew and fellow passengers restrain an allegedly violent passenger aboard American Airlines Flight 618 from Dallas-Fort Worth to Newark on September 3. The flight diverted to Baltimore, where law enforcement took over. Gun For Hire has collected the interviews, video, and national coverage.

updates.title: NJ Assault-Firearm and Magazine Ruling Stayed
updates.summary: The en banc Third Circuit previously held New Jersey's bans on commonly owned semiautomatic rifles and magazines capable of holding more than 10 rounds unconstitutional. On August 4, 2026, the court granted New Jersey a stay while the State seeks U.S. Supreme Court review. While the stay remains in effect, New Jersey's current assault-firearm restrictions and 10-round magazine limit remain enforceable.
updates.sourceTitle: NRA-ILA — Third Circuit Grants Stay in AWB/Mag Ban Case

updates.title: NJ Carry Restrictions Await En Banc Third Circuit Ruling
updates.summary: The full Third Circuit is reconsidering challenges to New Jersey's post-Bruen carry restrictions, including numerous designated sensitive places and related carry provisions. En banc oral argument was held on February 11, 2026. After the U.S. Supreme Court's Wolford decision, the parties filed supplemental briefs on July 8, 2026. The en banc Third Circuit decision remains pending.
